title: Deep-merge configs
hints: Write a helper that merges exactly two dicts, then apply it left to right over *configs starting from {}.
In the helper: start from a copy of the first dict, then for each key in the second, recurse when BOTH the existing value and the new value are dicts, otherwise just assign the new value.
isinstance(x, dict) is the test; lists fail it, so they get replaced by the else branch automatically.
copy.deepcopy(result) before returning guarantees no nested list or dict is shared with the inputs.
